2.49.2 List.Style
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.Style element specifies the style information for a List. This element is optional and is of type
Style.
Following is the parent element of the List.Style element.
Parent elements
 List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
